$comment: Shield User (OS Asher model, wiki 2026-11). Blastoise's kit until 2026-11-06, now Hisuian Arcanine's (Rock Slide = Water Pulse, Flare Blitz = Rapid Spin, Flamethrower = Hydro Pump). Water Pulse = Barrier Beam (0.55 s wind-up; centre sweet spot 175+87.5 %, LIGHT sides at 60 %; a barrier that is bigger and lasts on your own half, flimsy on the enemy half). Rapid Spin = Breakthrough (14.5 s dash that stops on the first enemy; 25 % damage reduction for 5 s) plus GAME_BREAKDOWN §13's guard: knockback resist while spinning, ended by Stagger damage. Hydro Pump = §13 channelled push beam (multi-hit like Pathsplitter's centre: 50+25 % dmg, 100+50 % KB per pulse... halved per pulse here). Player knockback = OS × 1.875; power % → powerRatio.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.desc: Wind up, then fire a pulse: its centre hits hard, its edges are LIGHT. A rock wall rises in front of you, stronger and longer-lasting on your own half.

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.desc: Charge forward wreathed in fire (knockback resist, half damage), stopping on the first enemy. Then take 25 % less damage for 5 s. Rock Slide can be cast mid-charge.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.desc: Breathe a wide stream of fire forward for 1.5 s (slowed), steadily pushing enemies and the ball away.
